_comment: Single source of truth for server/ file wiring status. Verified automatically by scripts/check-docs.js against static import analysis from server/index.js — do not hand-edit the 'status' of an entry without also making the corresponding wiring change (or vice versa), the check will fail on mismatch. Status values: 'live' (reachable from server/index.js), 'not-wired' (implemented but nothing currently imports it), 'legacy-unused' (superseded, kept in the repo, not imported by anything live).
